kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Tiny krill are turning up in deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Scientists want to know why
wire.summary: Antarctic krill serve as a crucial food source for penguins, seals, and whales. They recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers say they've found krill in a surprising place: hydrothermal vents.

wire.title: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers
wire.summary: Farmers in states bordering Canada say they are reeling from President Trump's trade wars and resulting retaliatory tariffs. And it's just not neighborly.

wire.title: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
wire.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.

wire.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
wire.summary: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.

wire.title: NATO jets shoot down a drone in Lithuanian airspace
wire.summary: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv.

wire.title: Get ready for yet another cost when buying a home: Junk fees
wire.summary: Some real estate agents and researchers say home buyers and sellers should not pay this out-of-pocket fee.

wire.title: NASA rushed engineers out of their labs. They say it risks future space missions
wire.summary: NASA employees say they've lost vital equipment and staff needed to make sophisticated spacecraft amid the agency's abrupt relocations over the past several months.

wire.title: This  bill could reshape crypto in America -- and it's sparking a major battle
wire.summary: The legislation would establish rules of the road for the crypto sector for the first time — but opponents are up in arms, and the bill faces an uncertain prospect in the Senate.

wire.title: For thousands of Haitians in the U.S., end of protected status brings fear, grief and defiance
wire.summary: Haitians in the U.S. lost their Temporary Protected Status under Trump's immigration crackdown. Now facing deportation to a homeland wracked by gang violence, disease and extreme poverty, Haitians in Miami are meeting the moment with grief, anger, and courage.

wire.title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon to share a stage to promote curbs on AI
wire.summary: The poles of U.S. politics are coming together over AI. Sanders and Bannon will appear at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington, D.C., to convince Congress to work faster to curb the impact of AI.

wire.title: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
wire.summary: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.

wire.title: What weapon could the US have put into space?
wire.summary: The announcement by the US points to a developing field of modern warfare in the Earth's orbit.

wire.title: Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
wire.summary: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.

wire.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
wire.summary: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.

wire.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
wire.summary: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".

wire.title: Canada is a 'safe harbour' for global finance, Carney says
wire.summary: The prime minister is hosting a major global investment summit, with the goal of attracting money into the country amid a trade war with the US.
